Maria: Heads-up — bringing up HF chat model "openchat/wizard-13b" and the Jinja-based chat_template -> Redwood prompt converter is producing weird artifacts.

Kevin: Which artifacts?

Maria: Example HF template we imported:

```jinja
{% if system %}
{"role":"system","content":"{{ system }}"}
{% endif %}
{"role":"user","content":"{{ user }}"}
```

Kevin: And the converted prompt?

Maria: Converter output (what we fed into Redwood):

```text
SYSTEM: {{ system }}
USER: {{ user }}
```

Maria: Runtime issue: model sees extra BOS token and the system block gets duplicated when system is empty; token counts off by +2 per request, batching/kv-cache behavior changes. Also special tokens look different: HF tokenizer has "<s>" BOS while Redwood runtime expects none.

Devon: This is likely two things — the converter left Jinja markers unrendered when system=="" and the tokenizer model config is inconsistent. Try this quick tokenizer check:

```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("openchat/wizard-13b")
print(tok.convert_tokens_to_ids(["<s>","</s>"]))
print(tok.encode("SYSTEM: hello\nUSER: hi"))
```

Sara: Also check model's config.json — some HF uploads set "bos_token_id": null or add an extra "additional_special_tokens" entry. If the tokenizer has a dedicated BOS we need to strip it in conversion or opt-in in runtime.

Maria: I ran a small eval: with the converted prompts, answers were shorter and sometimes cut-off mid-sentence. eval-bot posted a regression:

eval-bot: regression: conv-chat-template test -> response_length -12% (p=0.02) ; top1-quality -4%

Kevin: Sounds like prompt framing changed. Two proposed fixes:
- Pre-render Jinja templates server-side before ingestion (so no raw tags in prompt).
- Map HF role objects to Redwood role markers explicitly, e.g. "<system>...<user>" -> remove extra BOS.

Devon: Another quick patch — in hf-to-redwood script, if template contains "{% if system %}" then render with empty string rather than leaving the markup, and normalize tokens:

```python
def render_and_normalize(template, ctx):
    rendered = jinja_env.from_string(template).render(**ctx)
    # remove leftover jinja artifacts
    rendered = re.sub(r"\{\%.*?\%\}", "", rendered)
    # map roles
    rendered = rendered.replace('{\"role\":\"system\"', 'SYSTEM:')
    return rendered
```

Sara: Agree. Also add a tokenizer sanity check in onboarding docs:

- print tok.tokenize + encode lengths for sample prompts
- warn if bos_token_id != None

Maria: I\u2019ll open a PR in devex/hf-to-redwood with:
- pre-render step
- jinja artifact stripper
- role mapping rule
- unit test: tokenizer length parity (hf vs converted)

Kevin: Add a regression test to eval harness to catch response_length drop >5%.

Maria: Created draft PR #428 and added reviewers @Devon @Sara :thumbsup: 

Devon: I\u2019ll take the tokenizer normalization change.

eval-bot: scheduled re-run of evals in 2 hours, posting results to this thread.

Maria: Thanks — will monitor. :crossed_fingers:
